sources.snippet: cs Kasandra - Local AI Voice (CZ) Kasandra is a high-quality, local Czech voice model built for Piper TTS. It is designed to bring natural-sounding Czech speech synthesis to your smart home (e.g. Home Assistant) without the need to send a single byte of data to the cloud.
